description:
The scheme referred to as WRFLNSCS-FBPS is the Welfare Scheme for the Rehabilitation of Families of Landless Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance and support to families belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes who are landless. 

The primary objective is to improve the living standards of these families by providing them with financial aid for livelihood activities. 

Benefits include financial assistance for various livelihood options such as self-employment and skill development. 

Eligibility is restricted to families belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes who do not own any land. 

The application process typically involves submitting an application to the local government office or designated authority. 

The timeline for assistance may vary based on the processing of applications and availability of funds. 

Implementing authorities include state governments and local administrative bodies.
